titles.title: The One at the Center of the Rumors

description:
["The shaman's daughter in Class 2-1 supposedly sees ghosts."]

Eun-ha was at the center of all sorts of rumors—dubbed the shaman's daughter and a girl with a foul temper. There was not a single adult to look after her.

Then there was Gye Cheon-young, the only person who called her by her proper name rather than labeling her the shaman's daughter. A national Taekwondo athlete loved by everyone, he was the polar opposite of her.

"If you don't have a girlfriend, will you go out with me?"

A confession made on a whim. Cheon-young readily accepted.

Although their romance started haphazardly, it was happy. It was overwhelmingly heart-fluttering and cozy.

However, malicious rumors continued to follow Eun-ha, and an exhausted Eun-ha eventually left Cheon-young behind.

10 years later. They unexpectedly reunite in a place free from the labels of being a shaman's daughter or any other stigmas.

"I've been looking for you for a long time, Eun-ha."

Their unfinished first love had never truly stopped.

"You started it first 10 years ago. This time, it's my turn. So you better be prepared."
